product_description: Job Application Tracker helping job seekers track applications, analyze application velocity, funnel conversions, response rates, and platform ROI.
audience: Active job seekers (software engineers, professionals) tracking job applications, analyzing funnel performance across platforms, and identifying response/interview bottlenecks.
known_pain_points: Metric definitions differ between sections, salary parsing, duplicated KPIs, chart legibility, filter model limited to calendar month/year.
